_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: URLs in agent responses are linked (markdown mode). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. [data-testid="message-input"] should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Fill it with "echo: Check https://example.com and https://test.com". 4. Click [data-testid="send-button"]. 5. Wait for a ".message-agent" element to be visible (allow 30s). 6. The first ".message-agent .markdown-content a" (the agent's first link) should be visible. 7. Its href attribute must be exactly "https://example.com", its target exactly "_blank" and its rel exactly "noopener noreferrer" (pick it with the selector ".message-agent .markdown-content a" alone, which matches the first). 8. The second such link should be visible and have href exactly "https://test.com": eval Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".message-agent .markdown-content a")).slice(0, 2).map(a => a.getAttribute("href")) must give exactly ["https://example.com","https://test.com"], and ".message-agent .markdown-content a[href=\"https://test.com\"]" must be visible.
